# Authored content field reference

This document is packaged verbatim inside content/packs/text-data.json as documentation.gzipBase64. The source SHA256 and exact source path are retained. Runtime inspection reads the packaged bytes; it does not require repository or donor access. Content integration and portable export adoption remain owned by Plans 23/31.

## Editing and authority

Host balance is authoritative for a run. DT-25 display/audio/bindings are player-local and never override host balance. Defaults below are proposed balance, not playtest certification. Every container default is the exact ordered union of its child rows; its SHA256 authenticates the full canonical JSON value. No omitted field has a hidden fallback. Paths are exact JSON pointers; units, bounds, dependencies and source evidence are copied from the actual field schemas. Metadata source snapshots are evidence, not another balance authority.

## Representative edits

- Item: content/config/items.json /definitions/0/weightKilograms changes IT-01 Money from 0.001 to 0.002 kg/item; preserve stable ID and canonical image/text references. Validate with data.items-combat.
- Cost: content/config/structures.json /tiers/1/price changes main tier2 price from200 to220 crowns; keep fullValuation and repairFee consistent with the chosen designer valuation. Repair valuation remains independently documented as 50% of the full tier cost; never bill proportional missing health. Validate with data.map-structures and ui.camp.
- Zombie: content/config/zombies.json /archetypes/0/health changes Shambler health from65 to70; this changes only that archetype; keep loot/content references. Validate with data.zombies.
- Independent progression: content/config/zombie-progression.json /stages/0/regularPerPortal changes stage0 regular wave count from6 to7 independently of the archetypes file; preserve stage order, six portal relationships, positive counts and unchanged living zombie stats. Validate with data.zombies and data.campaign.
- Sound: content/audio/events.json event bindings retain their AU IDs and exact current sample/bank IDs; change /events/0/routes/0/gainLinear (footstep.walk) from0.85 to0.75 linear amplitude, a finite nonnegative number, never invent a path or use a donor absolute locator at runtime. Validate audio lifecycle and held-out cases.
- Map: content/config/map-sites.json /portals/0/x changes left.portal.1 from-100 to-102 world units, synchronizing its content/world/map.json position and ordering; retain six authored locations and references to content/world/map.json; edit a coordinate with strict path/site/edge validation and no procedural generation. Validate data.map-structures and world.inspector.

## Text schema and DT-18

TXT-01 is English; rows have stable id, text, typed placeholders, optional zero/one/other plural forms, exact source bindings and optional bindingRef. Counts are nonnegative integers. Current bindings come from DT-25 by action identity, never fixed key art. TXT-02 is replacement test data, not an additional shipped locale; placeholders and IDs are identical and every label has at least twice its original length. Accented names, multiline errors, long unbroken identities and unsupported glyph diagnostics are explicit. A missing glyph remains an unavailable diagnostic even when a fallback renders another glyph.

DT-18 points to this entire field inventory, catalog and independently editable DT-14. Text/data pack schemaVersion and version are positive stable integers. documentation includes sourcePath, sha256, encoding UTF-8 and full text. bindings list exact packaged paths and hashes. No actual save transaction or gameplay editor is supplied.

## Packaging and compatibility

Include content/packs/text-data.json, both text resources and their declared bindings explicitly in the portable content closure; documentation.gzipBase64 is the bundled copy of this file. TXT-02 is an inspection replacement fixture, never an advertised locale. DT-24 compatibility is metadata only: IDs, versions, saved geometry, equipment, exploration, ruins, paid work, queues and current loops; there are no duplicated image/audio payloads. Plans 23/31 retain final index/export reconciliation.
